import networkx as nx

known_edges = [(2,5), (8,11), (0,2), (5,9), (2,10), (2,11), (4,13), (7,14), (2,13), (11,14), (4,6), (9,10), (4,14), (12,13), (3,4), (0,7), (1,5), (2,3), (5,8), (11,12), (7,10)]

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(15))
G.add_edges_from(known_edges)

print("Connectivity:", nx.node_connectivity(G))
# print("Max independent set:", len(nx.maximal_independent_set(G))) # this is just one maximal
# To find maximum independent set:
max_ind_set = nx.algorithms.clique.graph_clique_number(nx.complement(G))
print("Max independent set size:", max_ind_set)

from itertools import combinations

edges = list(combinations(range(15), 2))
solution = []
for u, v in edges:
    solution.extend([u, v])

print(solution)
